purpose: Capture earlier requests and missed work without treating implementation, measured validation and deployment as interchangeable.

statuses.shipped: Present in the prior release; evidence has the stated scope, not universal device coverage
statuses.partial: Implemented in part or missing requested validation
statuses.superseded: Replaced by a later explicit user choice
statuses.infeasible-as-stated: Requested guarantee cannot be provided by the proposed mechanism

items.request: Create UT2K4 repository and GitHub Pages
items.scope: Implementation merged to main and GitHub Pages workflow passed; protected game updated and live verified.

items.request: Port and ship the demo
items.replacement: Full game, using existing native WASM port.

items.request: Research existing WASM work and reuse it
items.scope: rgnv v0.2.0 native engine; no claim of independently porting the engine from scratch.

items.request: Search ut2k4 wasm using Kagi in Orion
items.remaining: Exact requested browser/search-provider workflow is not established by the retained evidence.

items.request: Full collection on our deployment without an external content redirect
items.scope: Protected Cloudflare release; public Pages remains a launcher. The game runtime and assets are served from the protected deployment.

items.request: Support mutators and original Monkey Matrix Moves
items.remaining: Original mod excludes Assault/Onslaught; multiplayer prediction and all engine-version combinations are not validated.

items.request: Preserve recovered source on GitHub
items.scope: The repository owner has an encrypted GitHub draft release containing both 66-class recovery trees. Each recovered file was verified against its existing SHA-256 fingerprint and the downloaded archive digest was verified. Public assets contain the authored tooling and fingerprints.

items.request: Implement with GPT-6.1 Sol subagents in parallel
items.scope: Current engine, terrain and mesh work is delegated to existing Sol agents.

items.request: Automatically start the engine and reach the main menu
items.scope: After unlocking the protected deployment. Audio can still require a trusted user gesture.

items.request: Capability-dependent touch controls, especially iPhone
items.remaining: Browser touch emulation and WebKit checks exist; physical iPhone performance, memory limits, multitouch and sustained gameplay remain hardware checks.

items.request: Focus on Metal for best performance per watt
items.remaining: WebGL through browser-selected ANGLE Metal was observed on the tested Mac. No native Metal backend, direct Metal control, or measured power-per-frame claim.

items.request: Passphrase-protected full deployment with no application hints before unlock
items.scope: Opaque encrypted content and neutral locked shell; unauthenticated route checks passed. Private origin, credentials and passphrase stay out of public repository.

items.request: Decryption inside WASM so no reverse engineering can reveal content or its identity
items.remaining: WASM cannot hide a decryption key/plaintext from an authorized client or prevent guesses of a weak passphrase. Do not describe obfuscation or encryption as an absolute reverse-engineering guarantee.

items.request: Require eight characters except the chosen shorter passphrase
items.scope: Server-side length and derived-verifier checks accept the configured shorter passphrase or an authenticated passphrase of at least eight characters. The neutral client does not reveal the exception.

items.request: Double-tap an enemy to aim at them while visible in the viewport
items.scope: Also requires a living enemy and unobstructed aim/muzzle path; loss of visibility releases the lock.

items.request: Full auto-aim on by default as an add-on; correct weapon angles and crosshair
Third person by default
items.replacement: Later request: first person normally, third person during wallruns and sideways rolls.

items.request: Unlimited adrenaline, first person default, temporary third person during wallrun/roll, automatic wallrun on moving jump, Y toggle/hold option
items.remaining: Broad map/device coverage remains separate from the tested native scenarios.

items.request: Large red circular enemy lock marker and directional damage indicators
Halo-inspired regeneration as a default-enabled mod
items.scope: Five damage-free seconds then 20 HP per gameplay second; separate health mod, not a full Halo shields/damage-system reproduction.

items.request: Blood and gore off globally, not only in the add-on
items.scope: Verified against actual 3369 GameInfo: NoBlood is true at GoreLevel=0; xPawn and gib groups use that gate. Engine localization maps 0 to No Gore, 1 to Reduced, 2 to Full. The obsolete bLowGore flag is not needed.

items.request: Fix WASM out-of-bounds crash when a locked opponent goes around a corner
items.scope: Native callback recursion and stale target/owner/HUD references corrected; moving-target, firing, occlusion and map-travel soaks passed. This does not prove absence of every intermittent native crash.

items.request: Subtle progress with transferred MB versus expected MB and separate decoding/unpacking
items.scope: Actual observed encoded transfer and verified decode counts; expected phase totals are forecasts, not the whole collection or a guaranteed final byte count.

items.request: Audit startup and match dependencies, defer unnecessary reads and reduce cold latency
items.remaining: Menu and Rankin demand measured; exhaustive working-set and native compatibility coverage of all 861 maps is not complete.

items.request: Apply modern lossy codecs to in-game textures, audio and music, not just menu assets
items.scope: Current active profile 3,350,065,331 bytes, down from 3,977,789,262. Unsupported/unprofitable items retained; no whole-corpus perceptual-transparency claim.

items.request: Mono VBR quality 0, preserving original sample rate
items.scope: Supersedes 64 kbps stereo and the proposed lower sample rate. Existing smaller/unsupported originals are retained.

items.request: Subagent audit of all 8.5 GB and explanation of remaining ~4 GB / 2.35 GB maps
items.remaining: Current categories refreshed after the combined audit. Raw export bytes remain separate from compressed transport totals.

items.request: Reduce maps to about 200 MB
items.remaining: Current selected map bases are 1,720,023,813 bytes plus shared payloads; 200 MB is not achieved.

items.request: Fit the game around 200 MB / another 100–200 MB for the residual assets
items.remaining: Not achieved; do not equate a small first-match working set with the entire game.

items.request: Model, mesh and terrain at 10% of current size or smaller
items.remaining: Validated candidate reduces the full active collection from 3,977,789,262 to 3,350,065,331 bytes; map bases to 1,720,023,813 bytes. The requested 10% ratio has not been reached.

items.request: Capture all missed asset work
items.scope: All identified missed categories are captured with measurements and remaining actions. Selected profiles shipped; experimental or unsupported cases remain explicit in the asset ledger.

items.request: Commit, push, merge to remote main; update protected Cloudflare game and GitHub Pages
items.scope: PR5 merged into main; GitHub Pages published; protected Cloudflare game deployed and live verified. Size targets remain open independently of successful deployment.
